title: WPSS/728/2011 of SMT SHANTI NAYAL Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
WRIT PETITION NO.728 (S/S) of 2011
Smt. Shanti Nayal .........Petitioner
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand & others ..........Respondents
Present:
Mr. Lalit Sharma, Advocate, present for the petitioner.
Mr. Lalit Miglani, learned Brief Holder present for the State.
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia,J.(Oral)
Petitioner was a candidate for the post of Auxiliary Nurse Midwife
(which is known as ANM) in the Public Health Services, Government of
Uttarakhand pursuant to the advertisement dated 29th November, 2010.
However, amongst others, one essential condition was that the candidates
should not be less than 18 years of age and have not crossed the maximum
age of 35 years as on 1st July, 2010.
2. Admittedly, petitioner, on the 1st July, 2010, was over age by about
three months. The advertisement was for the entire State of Uttarakhand at
different districts. The total numbers of posts were 402. Petitioner was a
general candidate, for which there were 79 posts. Since the petitioner was
overage, the matter of the petitioner was recommended for age relaxation
by the Director General of Medical Health and Family Welfare on 27th
January, 2011 to the Additional Secretary, Government of Uttarakhand.
This matter was kept on pending with the Government and ultimately on
2
nd June, 2011 His Excellency the Governor was pleased to give
relaxation for four years under the Rules known as Uttarakhand Public
Service (Relaxation of age for recruitment) Rules, 2003. However, before
this relaxation could be granted, the candidature of the petitioner was
rejected on 31st March, 2011 on the ground that she has crossed the
maximum age limit.
3. When this petition was heard at the admission stage, the Court has
directed that one post of Auxiliary Nurse Midwife i.e. ANM shall be kept
vacant for the petitioner.
4. Presently, there is a special equity in favour of the petitioner,
inasmuch as, the government has already relaxed the age for the post for a

2
period of four years. Consequently, the rejection of the claim of petitioner
regarding age relaxation, when the some relaxation is infact granted to the
petitioner, though after her claim is rejected, would result in inequity.
5. In view of the above, the writ petition is allowed. A mandamus is
issued to the respondents to consider the candidature of the petitioner for
the post of ANM pursuant to the advertisement dated 29th November,
2010, treating her to be within the age limit and give her appointment, if
she fulfills all other requirements.
6. The needful be done within 8 weeks from the date a certified copy
of this order is produced.
